_readme: S444 (SkyBlueOak): Sierra College's catalog has no sitemap (404) and the index fallback read 3 pages, so 125 programs with a course list found 35; the 47 page-claimed all had only the associate-degree general education page as a candidate. Where do the program pages live, and how does a department page print each award?

questions.program_index: Which page lists every program or department, and what addresses do its links take?
questions.department_awards: On a department page, how is each award headed (A.A., A.S., Certificate of Achievement), and do its course lists sit under that heading?
